modelledOn.used_for: zone-bound exact-hostname all-paths self_hosted application, 24h session, HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax, exact-email allow policy (never a shared group or email_domain), gate before DNS

tsidp federated into Access as an OIDC IdP; allowed_idps pinned to Google Workspace, One-Time-PIN and tsidp; tsidp logins excluded from email policies and admitted only by a claim with a login_method requirement

include.values_source: exact operator email(s) supplied at apply; never committed, never a shared group or email_domain

exclude.reason: gftb pattern: tsidp rewrites @github/@passkey logins to non-routable addresses, so a tsidp identity is never admitted by email

policies.name: video-utils operators via tailnet (tsidp)
policies.note: Off until the operator rules on a tailnet capability claim for video-utils. Even when on, the origin admits only a verified Access JWT email on VIDEO_UTILS_OPERATOR_ALLOWLIST; whether that email is the operator's tailnet login for a tsidp sign-in is unknown (tsidp_claims_in_access_jwt, assertion_idp_visible_to_app).

policies.name: video-utils review service token
policies.note: Optional, by name only; no token id or secret is recorded. Inference (not verified against a live token): a service-token Access JWT carries no user email, so the origin verifier refuses it with 403 until a separate ruling adds service-token handling.

not_here: No bypass application: probes are tcpSocket inside the cluster, so no health path is exempt at the edge or at the origin.
No DNS record, tunnel route, IdP creation, application AUD or service token is created by this file; each is an operator act.
No secret values: Cloudflare API tokens, tsidp client credentials and service-token secrets stay in operator custody (sops / GitHub environment secrets set by stdin), names only.

origin_config_from_apply.VIDEO_UTILS_CF_ACCESS_TEAM_DOMAIN: the account team domain <team>.cloudflareaccess.com (issuer https://<team>, JWKS https://<team>/cdn-cgi/access/certs)
origin_config_from_apply.VIDEO_UTILS_CF_ACCESS_AUDS: the AUD tag of the application above, read back after apply
origin_config_from_apply.VIDEO_UTILS_OPERATOR_ALLOWLIST: the same exact operator email(s) as the allow policy
